title: Page → Board WebSocket message
description: Every text frame the page sends on /ws. A frame is at most 256 bytes. The Board answers anything that doesn't match this schema with an error of code badRequest.

commandId.description: Chosen by the page so it can match an error to the command that caused it. Unique among the page's own commands on one connection.

resync.description: Ask for a fresh snapshot, after the page saw a seq gap. Carries no id: the answer is the snapshot itself.

switchPreset.description: Ask the Quad Cortex to load a Preset. Confirmed by a current patch (always sent once the switch completes, even if the Current preset didn't change), or rejected by an error carrying the same id.

index.description: The Preset's index across the whole Catalog.

generation.description: The Catalog generation the page was showing when the user picked the Preset. The Board rejects a mismatch with staleCatalog.
